scope: Independent review of the stable private five-file formal-review-result and Claude child background-wait candidate only. Not integrated or deployed acceptance.

independent_findings.formal_review_binding: PASS. Goal-bound reviewer config is attached only for a reviewer assignment with a frozen candidate and takes candidate/Goal ID from the trusted assignment/stack record.
independent_findings.typed_result_and_publication: PASS. A formal result must parse as one unambiguous object, match the bound candidate, carry an accepted verdict, and contain nonempty string evidence. Validation occurs on the sanitized handoff before successful completion/publication.
independent_findings.failure_and_retry_boundary: PASS. Invalid progress prose/wrong candidate/ambiguous JSON/missing verdict or evidence fails the current task without publishing an artifact; the fixed failure instruction requests a new review task in the same Goal and does not echo invalid result text. Tests show a fresh assignment remains admissible and Goal state stays RUNNING.
independent_findings.negative_verdict_semantics: PASS. NOT READY, NOT_READY, and UNVERIFIED are valid completed review tasks; autonomy/runner.py still accepts only a candidate-bound READY artifact for Goal acceptance.
independent_findings.unaffected_jobs: PASS. Tests preserve freeform coder results, candidate-less component reviews, and legacy jobs; the stack loader does not attach the formal contract to these cases.
independent_findings.child_background_wait: PASS. Service Claude jobs and Goal owner/supervisor children receive CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS=0 via copied child environment and child-only --settings. Parent environment, non-Claude child flag behavior, and check-command argv remain unchanged. No new turn/runtime/retry caps were introduced.
independent_findings.assertion_preservation: The closed handoff reports 80 original agent assertions and 83 current autonomy assertions retained, plus 16 formal-result, 5 service child-setting, and 7 owner/supervisor child-setting tests. The autonomy diff appends the focused test class; no original source/test method deletion appears in the reviewed diff.

closed_candidate_suite.attribution: Closed author-run report inspected and bound through the exact handoff/source hashes; not independently rerun as one 191-test suite.

focused_independent_run.observed: 27 tests passed in the grouped scratch run. One additional test, test_failed_review_task_is_refused_by_goal_acceptance, first errored before its assertion because the scratch fixture path lacked the Windows extended-length prefix; that exact test then passed on a separate run using the intended extended-length path. No candidate assertion failed.
focused_independent_run.processes: All owned synthetic Python children exited; no live test child remains.
